newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU Commission holds off fine threat to KLM.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission holds off fine threat to KLM.

text.p: The European Commission has temporarily suspended possible moves against Dutch airline KLM amid signs that the carrier will provide data sought about its cooperation contracts with Northwest Airlines Corp., an official said Wednesday.
The suspension comes after EU legal experts said the text of a decision threatening fines against KLM had to be translated into Dutch before adoption.
More importantly, KLM representatives were said by the official to have been in contact with the EU executive on Wednesday to ask for a delay while they got data together.
"The Commission will probably decide this week whether they will accpet that," the official added.

The Commission announced anti-trust probes into six North Atlantic airline alliances last July, including the one between KLM and Northwest and the proposed link-up between British Airways and AMR Corp.'s American Airlines.
